<b>Alchemist's Assistant</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be started by talking to [[Alchemist Zylotol]] in the [[Wormways]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Plasmium.png|link=Plasmium|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Alchemist Zylotol asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to extract the nectar from three ripe [[Plasmium Bud|Plasmium buds]] found throughout the Wormways. He gives her his [[Needle Phial]], which she must charge and stab into buds to extract the [[Plasmium]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Alchemist Zylotol 01.png!Location of Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Plasmium buds.png!Locations of all the Plasmium buds
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Plasmium Phial.png|link=Plasmium Phial|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After delivering 3 Plasmium to Alchemist Zylotol, he rewards Hornet with the [[Plasmium Phial]] [[Tool]].
